name: Forwards To Target Group
description: A listener or listener rule forwards traffic to a target group (rule or listener -> target group): the last hop of load balancer -> listener -> rule -> target group (aws-core-tap#220). An Application Load Balancer listener's rules, its default rule among them, each forward to the groups their forward action names; a Network or Gateway Load Balancer listener has no rules, so its default action forwards straight to the group. The edge is light: what decides the route (priority, conditions, protocol, port) is on the rule and listener nodes, and the edge carries only the forward's weight, the one fact that belongs to the rule and group together. A rule that forwards to two groups by weight is two edges. Load balancers were this edge's source before listeners and rules became nodes; those rules remain, read empty, for one release so earlier edges are proposed for removal.

route_id.description: What forwards: the rule's ARN, or the listener's for a listener with no rules (Network and Gateway Load Balancers), which is the edge's own source. On the load balancer edges this release empties, it named the rule or listener the load balancer forwarded through.

listener_arn.description: Only on the load balancer edges this release empties; now on the rule or listener node. The listener the rule belongs to.

listener_port.description: Only on the load balancer edges this release empties; now on the rule or listener node. The listener's port; null when DescribeListeners gave none (a Gateway Load Balancer listener).

listener_protocol.description: Only on the load balancer edges this release empties; now on the rule or listener node. The listener's protocol (HTTP, HTTPS, TCP, TLS, UDP, TCP_UDP, GENEVE); null when not given.

rule_arn.description: Only on the load balancer edges this release empties; now on the rule or listener node. The rule's ARN; null for a listener's default action on a load balancer type that has no rules.

priority.description: Only on the load balancer edges this release empties; now on the rule or listener node. The rule's priority as AWS returns it: a number as text, or 'default' for the default rule; null when the route is not a rule.

is_default.description: Only on the load balancer edges this release empties; now on the rule or listener node. Whether this is the listener's default rule or default action, which applies when no other rule matches.

conditions.description: Only on the load balancer edges this release empties; now on the rule or listener node. The rule's conditions exactly as DescribeRules returns them (Field and its HostHeaderConfig, PathPatternConfig, HttpHeaderConfig, HttpRequestMethodConfig, QueryStringConfig or SourceIpConfig). Empty for a default rule or action.

weight.description: The forward's weight among the rule's or listener's target groups (ForwardConfig); null when the action names a single group with no weight.

discriminators.description: The rule or listener that forwards: the edge's own source. Kept in the key so the load balancer edges this release empties, where two rules could forward to one group at once, keep their identities until they are removed; set by the collector from DescribeRules or DescribeListeners.
